name: desktop_target_bind
description: Bind a running window, or launch a catalogued local app and bind its window, returning a target token.

hwnd.description: Bind this exact window handle; mutually exclusive with app_ref/window_ref

app_ref.description: app:<pid>:<process> or a catalog app_ref from desktop_targets_list

follow_dialog.description: When the selected window is disabled by a modal dialog (native Save/Open), bind that dialog instead
